title: Order the Score Total
story: Add up the scores in a dictionary. The lines are shuffled.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program prints 145.
hints: Both scores and total must exist before the loop.
The line that adds belongs inside the loop (indented). The print goes after.
socratic: What must exist before the loop?
Which line belongs inside the loop?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
